notes: A security fix for your licence. The check that stops a wound back clock kept its record in one file, and deleting that file reset it. It now keeps a second copy somewhere else and the two repair each other, and the app and the bot now read the same rule so they can never disagree about your licence. Nothing is reset by this update and your settings are untouched. Press Refresh game helper once after it installs, with the game closed.
